newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London weaker after HK record.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London weaker after HK record.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were steady to weaker on Tuesday after the Hang Seng Index posted a record close in Hong Kong earlier today, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index fell 6.02 points to 13479.31 by the close after the Hang Seng Index rose 245.94 points to a record at 13,485.33.
Dealers said the market in London was featureless with exception of HSBC Holdings which gained HK$1-1/8 in London to HK$164-1/8. The shares closed at HK$163.00 in Hong Kong.
"We have not seen any real follow through into London after today's rise in Hong Kong. There is a little two-way trade but no real features," said one trader.
